### Executive Summary: Sinar Everbright Trading Sdn. Bhd.

* **Registration No:** SYN-000511
* **Status & Type:** Active | Private Limited Company (Incorporated Dec 2007)
* **Industry/Location:** Retail (Online retail of baby products and toys) | Kuala Lumpur
* **Ownership Concentration:** Director 3 holds a controlling stake (72.7%), followed by Director 2 (16.81%) and Director 1 (10.35%).
* **Audit Standing:** Clean (Unqualified opinions across FY2022–FY2024 by Audit Firm 1). No recorded litigation.

---

### Financial & Operational Health (FY2022 – FY2024)

| Metric | FY2022 | FY2023 | FY2024 | Trend / Observation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Revenue** | 1,669,234 | 1,406,878 | 1,115,956 | 📉 Consistent top-line contraction |
| **Gross Profit Margin** | 30.6% | 32.1% | 34.7% | 📈 Improving pricing power / margins |
| **Net Profit After Tax** | 45,104 | 21,172 | 3,710 | 📉 Declining profitability |
| **Operating Cash Flow** | 92,496 | 91,321 | 16,385 | ⚠️ Sharp drop in cash generation for FY2024 |
| **Quick Ratio** | 0.73 | 1.22 | 1.39 | 📈 Strengthened short-term liquidity |
| **Leverage Ratio** | 0.66 | 0.43 | 0.33 | 📉 Actively reducing debt/liabilities |

---

### Verdict for Vetting Team

* **Worth a closer look?** **Conditional / Medium Priority.**
* **Strengths:** Clean audit history, zero litigation, improving gross margins, and a strengthening balance sheet with lower debt and better quick ratios.
* **Risks:** The company is experiencing a sustained multi-year decline in revenue and net profit, with net income nearly flattening out by FY2024. Operating cash flow also dropped significantly in the most recent financial year. 

**Recommendation:** Proceed to a closer operational check only if their product niche and pricing are critical; however, request up-to-date management accounts to verify if the downward revenue trend has stabilized.
